#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
    DEST="$1"
else
    DEST="${DEST:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"
fi

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination not set. Pass it as an argument or set DEST/BACKUP_DEST." >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "ERROR: logs/ directory does not exist." >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp -q "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE"
